Valley Ridge Listing Manager

eBay integration privacy policy

Effective October 10, 2026

This policy covers Valley Ridge Listing Manager, a private tool operated by Mark Wilson for preparing and submitting listings to the Valley Ridge eBay seller account. It does not describe the separate Valley Ridge storefront checkout or eBay's own services.

Purpose and access

The tool is being configured for the account owner's use. Once authorized, it will send owner-provided product details, images, prices, quantities, and selling settings to eBay to create or update listings. It will request only the account permissions needed for the enabled listing features. eBay handles sign-in and consent; the tool does not need your eBay password.

Data handling

The initial integration is limited to listing submission. It is designed not to maintain a database, archive, or persistent logs of information retrieved from eBay, including eBay listing responses, orders, buyer details, or messages. Any eBay responses needed to complete a request are intended to be processed temporarily and discarded. Product drafts supplied by the owner are separate from data retrieved from eBay.

Authorization credentials are used to authenticate requests and must be protected separately from public website files. Do not enter passwords, client secrets, or tokens into this public page. The integration is not yet connected merely because this policy is published.

Sharing and service providers

Listing information submitted through the tool is sent to eBay. The tool does not sell eBay account information or use it for advertising. Cloudflare hosts this policy page and may process technical request information, such as IP addresses, as part of delivering and securing the page. This policy page does not include analytics scripts, advertising trackers, or a data-collection form.

Your choices

The owner can stop using the integration and revoke its application access in eBay account settings. For questions about access, privacy, or deletion, contact markmusicality@gmail.com. Please do not include credentials in your message.

Changes to the integration

Before enabling features that persist information retrieved from eBay, this policy and the integration's data controls must be updated, and eBay's account-deletion notification requirements must be addressed. The effective date above will change when this policy is revised.
